name: egypt-advisor-tours-client
description: React frontend for Egypt Advisor Tours. NOTE: Most scripts are in the root package.json. Run 'npm run' from the root directory to see all available commands.

scripts.help:
echo '
⚠️  You are in the CLIENT directory!

Most commands should be run from the ROOT directory.

To go back to root:
  cd ..

Then run:
  npm run install:all     (install all dependencies)
  npm run start:client    (start this client)
  npm run start:server    (start the server)

For more info, see GETTING-STARTED.md in the root directory.
'
